title: 🏈 The Half-Time Show Mystery
intro: Whiskers, Luna, Oliver, and Bella are stars of the big game -- by day they play a favorite sport, and at half-time they each play an instrument in the band! Can you match them all up?
clues: Luna's sport is not Swimming, Soccer, or Basketball.
Bella does not play Piano or Violin.
hints: Clue 2 rules out three sports for Luna all at once -- whatever's left over is her answer. Start there.
Clue 7 tells you Luna's instrument directly: Violin. Mark that one with confidence!
Clues 4 and 5 don't name a cat -- they link an instrument straight to a sport. Once you know a cat's sport, check whether it matches either of those clues.
Clue 3 narrows Bella down to just two instruments left. Try combining it with clue 5 (Guitar -> Soccer) to see which one fits Bella.
Once Bella and Luna are settled, clue 1 and the leftovers sort out Whiskers and Oliver -- use clue 6 last to confirm Oliver's instrument.
